title: FlowReport
description: Declarative report-override flow document (Story 8.7, Epic 8 Part D + Refinement R6). Overrides/extends a module report pack (base_report_id). Includes R6 fields metric_definitions + llm_commentary_guidelines NOW so Stories 8.8 (widget affordances) and 8.9 (LLM commentary grounding) consume them. GUARDRAIL: additionalProperties:false everywhere — no secret field can appear.

id.description: Override id. For a report flow the id equals base_report_id (one override per (project, base_report_id)).

base_report_id.description: The module report pack this override extends, as '<module_name>/<report_def_id>'.

layout.description: Chart/layout hints (chart_type, order_by, top_n, ...). Free-form; merged over the base pack layout.

metric_definitions.description: R6: per-metric semantic grounding, keyed by metric name. Used as UI affordances (8.8) AND LLM commentary grounding (8.9).

llm_commentary_guidelines.description: R6: report-level guidance for the LLM narrative (tone, focus, what to avoid).

card_template.description: Story 9.8: preferred card template id for this report (e.g. 'kpi', 'conversions', 'connectors'). get_report / get_card serve this template's widget when set; an explicit LLM template argument still overrides. An unknown id is ignored at render time with a structured warning (never breaks the report). Pattern-guarded to card-id charset.
